optimized_sql:
WITH store_hot AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        customer.c_last_name,
        customer.c_first_name,
        date_dim.d_date
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN date_dim
        ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer
        ON store_sales.ss_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
    WHERE date_dim.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1189 + 11
),
catalog_hot AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        customer.c_last_name,
        customer.c_first_name,
        date_dim.d_date
    FROM catalog_sales
    JOIN date_dim
        ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer
        ON catalog_sales.cs_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
    WHERE date_dim.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1189 + 11
),
web_hot AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        customer.c_last_name,
        customer.c_first_name,
        date_dim.d_date
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN date_dim
        ON web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer
        ON web_sales.ws_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
    WHERE date_dim.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1189 + 11
),
hot_cust_count AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT count(*)
    FROM store_hot
    JOIN catalog_hot
        ON store_hot.c_last_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM catalog_hot.c_last_name
       AND store_hot.c_first_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM catalog_hot.c_first_name
       AND store_hot.d_date IS NOT DISTINCT FROM catalog_hot.d_date
    JOIN web_hot
        ON store_hot.c_last_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM web_hot.c_last_name
       AND store_hot.c_first_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM web_hot.c_first_name
       AND store_hot.d_date IS NOT DISTINCT FROM web_hot.d_date
)
SELECT *
FROM hot_cust_count
LIMIT 100
